newsitem.title: USA: Prudential's Acampora sees Dow at 8000 by end 97.
newsitem.headline: Prudential's Acampora sees Dow at 8000 by end 97.

text.p: Prudential Securities' director of technical research Ralph Acampora said on Wednesday he expects U.S. stocks to continue their bull stampede in 1997, ending the year with the Dow industrials at 8000.
The gain would mark a 24 percent rise for the Dow from its 1997 starting point at 6448. The Dow gained 26 percent in 1996.

Acampora, updating his established bullish stance, forecast the Dow would trade in a range between a low of 6200 and a high of 8250 during 1997. The blue chip index ended Wednesday off 51 points at 6549.
